docs.text: Americans are now sorely at risk of food poisoning. I thank my lucky stars I was born on the northern side of Lake Ontario. All this US shite is making all the winters I've endured worth it!

The influx of undocumented Canadians swimming across Lake Superior in the hope of arriving upon our hallowed shores and finally having the freedom to go bankrupt paying for basic medical care is simply too great; we can’t handle it alone! 😩
I'm more excited about Canada pulling an UNO reverse and making a claim on the Great Lakes States. Looking forward to the free Healthcare myself.

Dear Canada:
Please invade us and make the Great Lakes area part of your great country. We really need the healthcare and sanity.
An ER and trauma doctor, you say? You know, Canada would never treat a person of this caliber that way...'wiggles Great Lakes seductively'

🇺🇸 ❤️ 🇨🇦 (Even though our president is a tyrannical geriatric toddler.) ((Also, if shit pops off and the US heartland declares war on the US coasts, Canada should annex the Great Lakes. If being American is off the table, I could be Canadian real fucking easy. (Sorry, for cussing.)))
Canada to have influx of medically bankrupt American refugees swimming across the Great Lakes?

It’s how it should be!! (I’m in Canada so get *most* healthcare stuff covered… tho teeth are still luxury bones for most ppl🫠) Every day I’m reminded how lucky I am that I wasn’t born on the other side of the Great Lakes (even tho borders are oppressive bullshit) bc idk how USians cope down there🫠🫠

MASA. Make America Sick Again. I was born and grew up before the clean air and water acts in a small city on the shore of Lake Ontario with a coal fired power plant. I suffered from asthma until after I moved out of the city.
I'm picturing Canadian doctors on boats in Lake Erie, offering vaccine clinics.
It’s actually becoming a huge problem with so many Canadians swimming across Lake Huron to bankrupt themselves paying for minor surgeries.

But your Libertarian overlords are not disturbed by that. "If those weaklings can't afford health care, they shouldn't get sick!" is about how they see it. I am very happy I was born on the north shore of Lake Ontario (notwithstanding the cold).
